title: Good Morning, Little Friends!
visual_style: Soft pastel colors, large expressive eyes, simple shapes, and gentle movements

scenes.narration: Mintu the baby elephant wakes up and stretches his trunk.
scenes.visual_direction: A baby elephant lying on a soft bed, stretching its trunk upward with a sleepy smile.
scenes.child_safe_reason: The elephant is in a cozy bedroom, not moving or jumping.
scenes.future_image_prompt: Baby elephant waking up in a soft bedroom, stretching trunk, calm expression, pastel colors

scenes.narration: Lali the lion cub says hello with a gentle smile.
scenes.visual_direction: A small lion cub standing next to Mintu, smiling warmly with open arms.
scenes.child_safe_reason: The lion cub is calm and smiling, not aggressive.
scenes.future_image_prompt: Lion cub smiling gently in a bedroom, arms wide, happy expression, soft lighting

scenes.narration: Bunty the rabbit hops slowly to the garden.
scenes.visual_direction: A small rabbit hopping through a garden with flowers, looking around with big eyes.
scenes.child_safe_reason: The rabbit is hopping peacefully in a safe garden area.
scenes.future_image_prompt: Rabbit hopping in a garden, curious eyes, soft sunlight, colorful flowers

scenes.narration: Ginni the giraffe looks at the tall green leaves.
scenes.visual_direction: A giraffe standing tall among trees, looking down at green leaves with a peaceful face.
scenes.child_safe_reason: The giraffe is calmly observing nature without any movement that could cause harm.
scenes.future_image_prompt: Giraffe looking at tall green leaves in a forest, calm posture, bright sky above

scenes.narration: Chikki the duckling splashes softly near the pond.
scenes.visual_direction: A duckling splashing gently in a calm pond, surrounded by lily pads.
scenes.child_safe_reason: The duckling is splashing safely in shallow water with no risk of falling.
scenes.future_image_prompt: Duckling splashing softly in a pond, surrounded by lily pads, happy expression

scenes.narration: Tara the turtle walks home as the moon comes out.
scenes.visual_direction: A turtle walking slowly under a starry night sky, with the moon shining above.
scenes.child_safe_reason: The turtle is walking peacefully at night, not in any danger.
scenes.future_image_prompt: Turtle walking slowly under a night sky with stars and moon, calm and sleepy

scenes.narration: All the animal friends wave together and say, Good night!
scenes.visual_direction: Show all the animal friends together in one wide shot, smiling and waving to the audience under a calm night sky.
scenes.child_safe_reason: The friends are together, smiling, and peacefully saying good night.
scenes.future_image_prompt: All animal friends waving goodbye in a cozy bedroom, happy expressions, soft lights
